title: 30A Inshore Charters
specs: Fishing in calm, shallow waters with coastline always in sight
Target species include redfish and speckled trout
Up to four anglers per charter
Every charter is private for your group and Captain Cody, up to four anglers
blurb: Guests embark on private fishing trips in Choctawhatchee Bay targeting redfish, speckled trout, and other inshore fish. Trips offer calm, shallow water fishing with the coastline always in sight. Options include a full 4-hour charter or a shorter 2-hour kid-friendly charter.
extraNote: Departs from Cessna Landing boat ramp
